class.name: RailVehicleAppearance
class.brief_description: What a kind of rail vehicle looks like.
class.description: The models a kind of rail vehicle is drawn with and the submodels of its exterior model that move - bogies, wheels, pantograph arms, wipers, mirrors. Shared by every vehicle of the kind and handed to [RailVehicleRenderingServer]. Submodels are named as the model names them; a missing one is an empty name.
